items.q: How much does an Airbnb launch cost?
items.a: DTCM licence — 1,800 AED/year, photoshoot — $400, furniture/decor (if needed) — $4–8K. All of it pays back in 1–2 months of operations.
18% of gross revenue — it covers 24/7 hosts, dynamic pricing, monitoring 12 platforms, monthly reports. No hidden charges.

items.q: Can I live there myself in low season?
items.a: Yes. Book your dates and we block the calendar. That flexibility is impossible with long-term rentals.

items.q: What if neighbours / HOA push back?
items.a: Before the deal we check the building NOC for short-term. We don't buy where it's banned. The list of Airbnb-friendly buildings is openly available.
Top districts (Marina, Downtown, JBR) — 88–94% per year. Low-tier (JVC, Sports City) — 78–85%. We pull the numbers from AirDNA, not thin air.

items.q: What budget should I start with for Airbnb?
items.a: Minimum $250K (studio in Marina/Business Bay). Sweet spot $400–600K (1BR with a prime view, ADR $230+). Premium $800K+ (2BR, ADR $350+).

items.q: How many nights to break even?
items.a: At $230 ADR with average expenses, a $450K unit breaks even operationally at 14–16 nights per month. The normal 26–28 nights delivers 11% NET.
